title: Mississippi court revives landlord's $99,468 claim against couple
summary_full: A Mississippi appeals court has revived a landlord's $99,468 lawsuit against a couple over alleged unpaid rent and unfinished repairs. It ruled that the lower court wrongly dismissed the complaint without a request from the couple for summary judgment in their favour. The court has not decided whether they owe the money.
